title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ(森合秀樹研究室)
subtitle: Design Project III(Moriai Hideki)
keywords: Aernnautics and Astronautics 2.Thermo-fluid engineering 3.Thermodynamics 4.Steady and unsteady fluid phenomena 5.Regional contribution
educationalGoal: The objective of this course is to develop a basic ability to design, manufacture, and make feasible proposals for aircraft design, the application of aeronautical engineering theory, and the evaluation of actual phenomena related to aircraft.
advice: Specific project themes will be determined through discussion, and problems will be discovered and resolved according to these discussions. Themes can be broadly classified as follows. (1) Experiments and CFD research on the theme of improving the performance of existing aerospace engines such as rocket engines and jet engines. (2) Basic research on new technologies such as scramjet engines and detonation engines. Phenomenon elucidation and empirical research by experiments and CFD. (3) Proposal of futuristic innovative space propulsion engine using laser, plasma, etc. Basic research on phenomenon elucidation and principle demonstration by experiment and CFD.
requiredKnowledge: As Design Project III is based on previous lectures, it is necessary to review the experiments and the exercises in the department of aeronautics courses.

activityGoals.body: Be able to define project themes and act on engineering design processes.
Be able to summarize in reports, and present and discuss the reports.
Be able to design, draft, manufacture (production), simulate, etc.
